pending.textEn: @giadotai Sorry Gia. More resets coming next week
That was yesterday, today is DevDay. And it's all good news. I'm surprised we've kept it all under wraps.
Seeing some reports that the Pro 500 didn’t get the reset as expected earlier. Investigating and will make up for it

@poteto I challenge you to do the same

https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2106845241357824205?s=20
Over the next 28 days, each day we’ll either ship one thing that is a clear improvement and relevant for most codex/work users or ship a full reset. Let the improvements begin.
Four updates or a reset. Or both. How was day 2.

You can still claim the one time bonus credit for cloud sessions if you were on a Pro or Max plan on Sept 23. Run /claim-credit in Claude Code by Oct 7 at 11:59pm PT.

Cloud sessions use this credit first, then count toward your plan limits once it runs out or expires Nov 4.

http://support.claude.com/en/articles/17152539-cloud-sessions-bonus-credit-promotion

We shipped four things that were deemed good to great and some math proofs, but the vote is clear and the community demands a reset. I did calibrate it and it *seems* that the game is rigged in reset's favor, but such are the rules at the moment.

Therefore ... the reset has been processed. Enjoy!
Will be there by EOD PST.

We’re rolling out monthly Claude Platform API credits for Max and Team plans:

Max 5x: $100
Max 20x: $200
Team: up to $500, pooled

Works on any model, including Haiku 5.5, in your code or third-party harnesses. 

How it works and full terms: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17154008-monthly-api-credits-for-max-and-team-plans
Confirmed landed across all accounts. How are we doing so far?

How to build automations with Claude Managed Agents: https://claude.dev/blog/building-effective-agent-automations/

Deploy an agent that reads Slack/GitHub on a schedule (with credentials and memory) and posts updates. You can set it up with a Claude Code command and use the new API credits included in Max and Team.

ICYMI we've cut the price of Sonnet 5.5 cache reads in half.

In the Claude Platform, it's now $0.10 per million tokens (input is $2, output is $10). 

This means Sonnet 5.5 now runs ~20% cheaper on most agentic work. 

(API only, no change to Claude Code usage limits.)

The quickest way to get started with these credits is using Claude Managed Agents. Use the claude-api skill in Claude Code to build an agent and run it with your credits: 

/claude-api managed-agents-onboard

Credits can be used with the Messages API, Claude Managed Agents, and the Agent SDK, but cannot be used with interactive Claude Code sessions. These credits also apply in third-party harnesses that accept a Claude API key.

Monthly API credits are now available on Max and Team plans: $100 on Max 5x, $200 on Max 20x, and up to $500 pooled on Team. Use them on any Claude model.

How it works and full terms: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17154008-monthly-api-credits-for-max-and-team-plans
